description: Read and hash a local research directory on this machine, without uploading bytes or creating a receipt. Returns relative paths, local hashes and heuristic file roles to the connected AI app. Skipped: common repository, dependency and build folders, symlinks, files with more than one hard link, and common environment, key, credential, token, secret and shell-history names. Skipping is by name, so a secret in an ordinary-looking file is still listed and hashed.

exclude.description: Optional relative glob patterns that omit files in addition to protected defaults.

include.description: Optional relative glob patterns that select files.

rootPath.description: Local directory to inspect. The absolute root is never returned or sent to Papex. Refused: the filesystem root, the home folder itself and credential or system folders (such as ~/.ssh, ~/.aws, ~/.config, ~/Library, /etc).

name: papex_preview_capsule
title: Preview a local research capsule
